workflows.name: codebase-survey
workflows.description: Map a codebase's modules in parallel, then synthesize one architecture overview.

workflows.name: bug-sweep
workflows.description: Sweep code for bugs across 5 lenses in parallel, then adversarially verify each finding.
workflows.args: [path]  (optional, defaults to the current git diff)

workflows.name: compare-options
workflows.description: Compare options head-to-head: one researcher per option, then a scored table.
workflows.args: ["A","B",...]  or  A vs B vs C

workflows.name: dependency-audit
workflows.description: Audit dependencies in parallel for outdated, deprecated, and vulnerable packages.

workflows.name: test-gap-finder
workflows.description: Find under-tested code in parallel and propose concrete missing test cases.

workflows.name: release-notes
workflows.description: Turn recent commits/PRs into release notes: group by area, summarize, compile.
workflows.args: [git range]  (optional, defaults to changes since the last tag)

workflows.name: doc-audit
workflows.description: Audit docs against the code in parallel to find stale, wrong, and missing documentation.

workflows.name: api-surface-map
workflows.description: Map a project's API surface, document each route group in parallel, compile a reference.

workflows.name: scaffold-feature
workflows.description: Generate a feature: plan the change, write each file in parallel, then review.
workflows.example: /scaffold-feature add a /health endpoint returning JSON status

workflows.name: jira-digest
workflows.description: Pull Jira issues in scope, analyze each group in parallel, produce a sprint/standup digest.
workflows.args: [JQL / sprint / board]  (optional, defaults to the active sprint)
workflows.example: /jira-digest project = ENG AND sprint in openSprints()
